<!--
first-page numbers the pages of an article from where it begins in the issue
rather than from one, which is what a published article carries. apa7 sets the
page counter from it; apaquarto-latex-pdf had no counterpart.

Manuscript mode, where the running head carries the number on every page
including the first, so the offset can be read straight off page one. A
journal article is the likelier use, but its first page carries no head at
all, which would leave nothing to check.
-->

# Method

Text of the article, which should sit on page 45 rather than page 1.
